title: Fourier coefficient under translation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $a,\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the translated function $x\mapsto f(x+a)$ equals the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$, evaluated at $a$, times the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
